# Heist — AI Content OS
> The brains behind the operation. Heist is the AI content OS with a Brand Brain that learns your voice, audience, and past performance, then briefs your own AI to turn one idea into a month of on-brand social media content in one sitting.

Key product facts:
- Founded: 2025
- Category: AI Content Operating System / Social Media SaaS
- Platforms supported: LinkedIn, X (Twitter — via your own X developer app keys on a paid X API tier), Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WordPress, plus a hosted website blog. TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit coming soon.
- Pricing: Starter $19/mo, Pro $49/mo, Founder $99/mo, Agency $199/mo. Billed yearly: $192, $492, $984 and $1,908 a year ($16, $41, $82 and $159 a month), which saves about 2 months
- Free trial: 7-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required. When it ends the account locks until you choose a plan; your data is kept and you can still sign in to download it or delete the account
- AI: Heist runs on your own AI. Heist + your AI (the Claude/ChatGPT connector, over MCP) is included on Pro, Founder, Agency and the 7-day trial; Claude's custom connector works on any Claude plan, including Free, and ChatGPT needs a paid plan with developer mode turned on. Starter doesn't include Heist + your AI and writes with your own AI API key
- Limits: Starter 1 brand and 100 posts/month; Pro 1 brand and 500 posts/month; Founder 5 brands, 3 team seats and unlimited posts; Agency 25 brands, 10 team seats and unlimited posts. Founder and Agency include content approvals and roles
- Differentiator: Persistent Brand Brain with memory, voice drift detection, and real engagement data feedback loop

## What makes Heist different
Most AI content tools are stateless — they forget your brand after every session. Heist's Brain persists brand memory: voice profile, audience personas, memory facts, knowledge base, chat insights, anti-repetition tracking, performance patterns, smart onboarding, voice drift detection, and real engagement metrics. The longer you use it, the better it gets.
